description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminLeaderboard page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application for an online examination system. It contains event handlers for page load and button clicks, with database connection and query code commented out.

classes.name: AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: Web page code-behind class for AdminLeaderboard, handling page events and user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently with commented-out code to load data from the database.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the home button is clicked, transfers to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the profile button is clicked, transfers to AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for leaderboard button; currently empty.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Handles search button click; with commented code for database search, currently sets session variable with dropdown value.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles logout button click, transfers to LoginPage.aspx.
